DISCOVERY 612, PRESENT: KATI EVANS, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF/MOVING PARTY, MICHELLE SAYADA. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED WITH MODIFICATIONS. PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL DEFENDANT'S FURTHER RESPONSES TO PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS, FOR FURTHER RESPONSES TO PLAINTIFF'S EMPLOYMENT LAW FORM INTERROGATORIES, AND FOR PRIVILEGE LOG IS MOOT IN PART, GRANTED IN PART, AND DENIED IN PART. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS TO REQUEST NO. 39. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NOS. 40, 41, 42, AND 43. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NOS. 44, 45, 48, 49, AND 51. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NOS. 50 AND 57 AS IT SEEKS DOCUMENTS RELATING TO DEFENDANT HALL. ANY PRIVILEGED DOCUMENTS SHALL BE DESCRIBED IN A PRIVILEGE LOG. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NO. 52. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS TO REQUEST NOS. 53, 55, AND 56 AS IRRELEVANT. THERE IS NOTHING IN THE SEPARATE STATEMENT REGARDING NO. 54. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NOS. 58, 59, AND 60. THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NO. 67, LIMITED TO ACTIONS TAKEN BASED UPON COMPLAINTS OF DISCRIMINATION AND/OR RETALIATION AND/OR HARASSMENT. RESPOND WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. REQUEST #57 IS GRANTED. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
